ov: 8 نساء (الفرنسية: 8 femmes) هو فیلم موسيقي، وفلم كوميديا، وفلم جريمة، وفلم عيد الميلاد ‏، وفلم متعلّق بالمثليين ‏ أُصدر في 2002. الفلم من إنتاج كنال+، وسيلوليد دريمز ‏، وFidélité Productions ‏، و من إخراج فرانسوا أوزون، أما السيناريو فكان من كتابة فرانسوا أوزون، ومارينا دي فان، وروبرت توماس.
plotEn:
Suzon returns from school for Christmas break, finding her mother Gaby, her younger sister Catherine, and her wheelchair-using grandmother Mamy in the living room. Their conversation drifts to the subject of the family patriarch, Marcel, and Catherine leads the first song, "Papa t'es plus dans le coup". Suzon and Catherine's aunt Augustine awakens and argues with the rest of the family and the two servants (Madame Chanel and Louise), eventually returning upstairs and threatening suicide. Mamy jumps out of her wheelchair, haphazardly explaining her ability to walk as a "Christmas miracle". Augustine is eventually calmed down, and she sings her song of longing, "Message personnel".
The maid finds Marcel's stabbed body upstairs and screams. Preceded by Catherine, the others soon arrive at Marcel's room to see him stabbed in the back, and Catherine warns them against disturbing the room until the police arrive. Realizing that the dogs were quiet the night before, they realize that the murderer was known to the dogs and therefore must be one of the women in the house. Attempting to call the authorities, they find that the telephone line has been cut, but before they can go to the police station together, they are informed that an intruder is roaming the garden. It is revealed as Marcel's sister Pierrette, a nightclub singer and supposed prostitute, who has previously been barred from the house due to Gaby's intense dislike for her.
